display.purpose: Hero and section headlines, on two hand-broken lines.

headline.purpose: Names and titles inside a section.

title.purpose: Dialog and form-step titles, and large numbers.

body.purpose: Section intros and paragraphs, at 60 to 70% opacity of the text colour.

meta.purpose: The line of facts above or beside a headline: a client and year, the hero's opening line.

micro.purpose: Chips over media tiles and the calendar's legend. Nothing smaller is used for real text.

aside.purpose: Instrument Serif italic: section markers, a founder's full name, the phrase a headline leans on.

shadows.name: floating-object
shadows.purpose: A device or cover lifted off its card.

shadows.name: hover-card
shadows.purpose: Previews and tooltips that appear over content.

shadows.name: dialog-glow
shadows.purpose: A dialog's shadow is pink, so it reads as lit from behind.

shadows.name: focus-line
shadows.purpose: Thickens a field's bottom border on focus.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for everything that moves under CSS.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Controls dip to scale 0.97 while held.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Sections fade in; headlines rise line by line.

motion.name: pointer-spring
motion.purpose: Things that follow the pointer (tilt, previews, the nav pill) use springs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a section: Start a project, Send brief.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: var(--brand); color: var(--on-brand); font-weight: 500; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: A strong action on a busy or pink background: Close, Copy email.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: var(--brand); color: var(--on-brand); } .ds-btn-solid:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action beside a primary one: Back, Show all.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--paper); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn-outline:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Only for buttons laid over photos and video: Sound on.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 70%, transparent); color: var(--paper); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-glass:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A selectable pill: Library filters and the options in the project brief. Paper fill for pick-one, pink for pick-several.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 70%, transparent); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 50%, transparent); color: var(--paper); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--paper); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-chip-brand[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--brand); background: var(--brand); color: var(--on-brand); } .ds-chip:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: A small frosted label over media naming an industry or format. Informational, never a button.
components.css: .ds-tag-stage { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.75rem; min-width: 16rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand) 35%, transparent), transparent 60%), var(--ink-2); } .ds-tag { border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 60%, transparent); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tag-accent { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Field
components.description: A form field with no box: a hairline along the bottom that turns pink on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; min-width: 16rem; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; padding: 0.75rem 0; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--paper); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 30%, transparent); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--brand); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 var(--brand); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A round hairline button holding one icon: previous and next in a carousel.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Next"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 60%, transparent); } .ds-icon-btn:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Section Marker
components.description: Opens every section: a small moon whose phase follows the section's place on the page, beside its name in the italic serif.
components.html: Selected work
components.css: .ds-marker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-instrument, 'Instrument Serif'), Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--muted); } .ds-marker svg { width: 1.05em; height: 1.05em; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Card with Arrow Circle
components.description: A raised surface with a hairline border and a 2rem corner. The arrow circle marks the whole card as a link and turns pink on hover.
components.html: The AI Edge Daily, 2025-26Reach beyond the follow
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: block; min-width: 18rem; border-radius: 2rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--ink-2); padding: 2.5rem; color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-meta { display: block; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 60%, transparent); } .ds-card-title { display: block; margin-top: 1rem; padding-right: 3rem; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.045em; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: var(--accent); } .ds-arrow { position: absolute; right: 1.5rem; top: 1.5rem; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); transition: rotate 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-arrow { rotate: 45deg; background: var(--brand); color: var(--on-brand); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is deep space, and almost all of it is dark. Light arrives at one edge: the glowing pink rim of the hero's planet, the horizon the contact section rises over, a hairline of pink under the header as the page scrolls. Because light is rare here, wherever it falls is where the eye goes. Every decision in the system follows from that: surfaces stay flat and quiet so the rim can do the pointing.

The mood is cinematic, confident, warm and precise. Cinematic in the dark stage and the slow, deliberate motion. Confident in very large, tightly set headlines that say plainly what the studio does. Warm in the pink itself, the soft moonlight off-white in place of pure white, the italic serif asides and the founders shown as people. Precise in the hairlines, the consistent pills and the small labels that never fight the headline.

The site must never read as a generic agency template. Its shapes come from its own subject: crescents, orbits, horizons and phases, each doing a job (marking a section, showing progress, pointing at an action) and none of them used as stock decoration.
keyCharacteristics: A near-black stage with a single warm accent, used as light and never as wallpaper.
Two themes: night by default, a moonlight-paper day theme, with the hero, contact, footer and 404 staying night in both.
One sans family for everything, plus one italic serif used only as an aside.
Fully rounded controls that dip when pressed; large soft-cornered cards; no sharp corners.
Flat surfaces; depth comes from glow and from shadows under the few things that float.
Motion on one easing curve, switched off or simplified when the visitor asks for reduced motion.

rules.name: The Rim Light Rule
rules.body: Pink is light, not paint. It appears as the main action, a state, or a glowing edge. It never fills a section background.

rules.name: The Two Pinks Rule
rules.body: Use `brand` for fills and glow, `accent` for words. Only `accent` changes between themes, which is what keeps pink text readable on day.

rules.name: The Sixty Percent Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is Lunar Grey (`muted`) or the text colour at 60% opacity or more. Anything fainter fails contrast on the day theme, however fine it looks on night. Placeholders use Lunar Grey.

rules.name: The Night Islands Rule
rules.body: The hero, the contact section, the footer and the 404 page stay night in the day theme. Anything laid over them (the header, a hover card) takes the night palette with them.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Display type is set tight (line-height under 1, tracking around -0.045em) and broken by hand into two lines. Never let a headline wrap on its own into three or more.

rules.name: The One Aside Rule
rules.body: The serif is always italic, always weight 400, and never used for body copy, buttons or labels inside controls.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and section markers are sentence case at their natural tracking. No tracked-out capitals.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: If it scrolls with the page, it has no shadow. Shadows belong to things that sit above the page.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: To draw attention to something, light it (a pink glow, a lit rim) rather than raising it.

dos: Do keep pink rare: one primary action per section, states, and edges of glow.
Do use `brand` for fills and glow and `accent` for pink text, so the day theme keeps its contrast.
Do check every new piece of text in both themes; pink text on a pink tint passes on night and fails on day.
Do build every control as a full pill with the press dip (scale 0.97, 160ms).
Do set headlines in Outfit 700 on two hand-broken lines with tracking near -0.045em.
Do open a new section with the moon marker and its name in the italic serif.
Do take shapes from the subject (crescents, orbits, horizons, phases) and give each one a job.
Do keep the hero, contact, footer and 404 night in both themes.
Do give every pointer-only effect a plain equivalent for touch and keyboard, and respect reduced motion.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem tall and small labels at 11px or more on phones.
donts: Don't let the site read as a generic agency template: no stock layouts, and no grid of identical cards.
Don't fill a section background with pink, or add a second accent colour.
Don't use pure black or pure white for surfaces or text; the palette is Deep Space and Moonlight.
Don't put a shadow on anything that scrolls with the page.
Don't use sharp corners, thick borders or a coloured stripe down one side of a card.
Don't set labels in tracked-out capitals, or use the serif for body copy or controls.
Don't slide every section up as it enters; sections fade, and only headlines rise.
Don't run `shadcn init` or let a component library write its own colour variables into `globals.css`: `--accent` and `--muted` are this system's own names.
